identity.summary: UFC lists the Welsh lightweight as a British and Welsh judo champion. JudoInside's Mason Jones (GBR/WAL, born 1995) shares his birth date and holds the 2012 Commonwealth bronze.

national.note: The domestic Commonwealth Judo Championships, not the Commonwealth Games. The medal list's text has no age-group labels; JudoInside places the -60 kg podium (Malone, Pateman, Pappas, Jones) in the senior men's results, alongside senior champions Groom and Purssey. He was 16 at the time.
